_note: Joint-proof claims judged by tools/d65_strongly_connected_groups_gate.py against the REAL D65 engine (drift_canary/strongly_connected_groups.py, PR #2327). Empty 'claims' = explicit DORMANT (never a false green). The first claim merged activates enforcement with zero new wiring. Claims are evidence declarations: the gate rebuilds the JointDeclaration from the declared model (digest recomputed honestly unless 'presented_digest' is given, which is passed through untouched so the engine's tamper-refusal is judgeable) and runs verify_joint — an asserted verdict the engine disagrees with is BLOCKED (exit 1); an untrustworthy manifest is BROKEN (exit 2). D65's distinctive coverage: cyclically-dependent invariant groups must be proven jointly — no member may certify another, and the verdicts stay separate (a proven strategy with an exit is EXIT_POSSIBLE_NOT_GUARANTEED, never REPEATABLE_PROVEN).

_schema.evidence_ref: link to the evidence (board comment, run log, check run)
_schema.joint_name: the joint group's name (carried into the verdict)
_schema.asserted_verdict: REPEATABLE_PROVEN | DEADLOCK_IN_SCOPE | LIVELOCK_COUNTEREXAMPLE | EXIT_POSSIBLE_NOT_GUARANTEED | JOINT_UNDETERMINED — what the team claims the engine finds
_schema.declared_by: the external authority grounding the group (must NOT be a member)
_schema.members: non-empty list of unique member names forming one strongly connected component
_schema.prereq: object: member -> list of prerequisite member names (the joint's internal topology)
_schema.initial_states: non-empty list of candidate initial joint states
_schema.authorized_initial: list (may be empty) of the initial states the authority actually authorized
_schema.transitions: non-empty list of {src, dst (non-empty), kind: ordinary|replenish|reserve|complete, progress (int), authorization/capacity/owner (optional non-empty strings)} — the COMPLETE legal transition relation
_schema.exit_states: list (may be empty) of declared terminal states
_schema.presented_digest: optional 64-hex sha256 — passed through untouched so the engine's tamper-refusal is judgeable; only an asserted JOINT_UNDETERMINED can be certified for it

_example._comment: WORKED EXAMPLE — not an active claim. If registered as a claim, the gate CERTIFIES it (exit 0): the 4-member budget→lifecycle→replenishment→resource→budget cycle (AER-LIVE-010-SCC), declared by treasury (external), authorized initial s0_allocated, progressive cycle (progress 1 per step), replenish step authorized by treasury:auth-001, constructive exit s3_released→s4_exited. Engine: EXIT_POSSIBLE_NOT_GUARANTEED — the strategy is proven AND the exit is constructed, but the kernel can continue forever. The claim asserts EXIT_POSSIBLE_NOT_GUARANTEED: honest, certified. Flip asserted_verdict to REPEATABLE_PROVEN and the gate BLOCKS it (exit-swallowing: the exit dimension the engine keeps separate may not be collapsed). Set declared_by to 'budget' (a member) and assert anything but JOINT_UNDETERMINED: BLOCKED (the group would establish its own external facts).
